$comment: Security headers for Vercel. Safe headers are enforced; CSP ships Report-Only verify no violations against Stripe/Razorpay/Agora/GCS in the console, then rename 'Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only' to 'Content-Security-Policy' to enforce. SPA rewrite keeps client-side routing working. COOP must stay 'same-origin-allow-popups': plain 'same-origin' severs window.opener and breaks the Google Identity Services sign-in popup.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://storage.googleapis.com https://*.googleusercontent.com https://*.gstatic.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; script-src 'self' https://js.stripe.com https://checkout.razorpay.com https://*.gstatic.com https://accounts.google.com; frame-src https://js.stripe.com https://hooks.stripe.com https://api.razorpay.com https://checkout.razorpay.com https://accounts.google.com; connect-src 'self' https: wss:; worker-src 'self' blob:
